body.name: parent-range encoder loss
body.construction: \(\mathcal L_{\mathrm{enc}}(\widehat H,P)=\inf\{\|\widehat H-H^{\star}\|_{\mathrm{op}}: \|H^{\star}_{m,:}\|_2=1,\ H^{\star}_{m,:}{}^{\top}\in\mathcal S,\ U^{\top}H^{\star}_{m,:}{}^{\top}\in\operatorname{col}(R_m)\text{ for every }m\in[n],\ (H^{\star}G)_{m,I(j)}=0\text{ whenever }j\ne m\text{ and }j\not\to m\text{ in }\mathcal G_{\mathcal E}\}\).
